name: dsh-memory recall eval (hand-written paraphrases)
note: Paraphrase rows are the REAL measurement. Each question is phrased the way the user would actually ask, using words that do NOT appear in the fact it should find. Literal rows are auto-derived at run time and only prove substring matching works. Unanswerable rows come from the auto builder.
_why_these_queries: Written by hand against the 12 facts in the store on 2026-11-12. The point is that the wording differs from the stored text: '显存' vs '显卡内存', '什么时候跑 bat' vs '必须优先跑安装目录里的启动 .bat'. If the retriever only does substring matching these fail — which is exactly what we want to know.

queries.q: ComfyUI 怎么启动才不会一闪就退
queries.note: 用户不会说'缺 activate.bat 设置的环境'，只会说'一闪就退'
极短问句，没有'助手名'/'小智'这些字面线索
